name: Aalto University
description: Aalto University is a multidisciplinary research university in Espoo, Finland. It was formed in 2010 by merging three Finnish universities: the Helsinki School of Economics, the Helsinki University of Technology, and the Helsinki University of Art and Design. Aalto University provides Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctoral degree programs in subjects such as business, engineering, arts and design, and science. The university is well-known for emphasizing entrepreneurship, sustainability, and innovation. With students from over 100 countries, Aalto University boasts a varied and international student body. The institution also includes various research facilities and is dedicated to research and innovation. As Collab International, we will give you all the information to inform you.
